title: You Only Cache Once: Decoder-Decoder Architectures for Language Models
caption: Figure 1: Overview of the decoder-decoder architecture. Self-decoder generates the global KV cache. Then cross-decoder employs cross-attention to reuse the shared KV caches. Both self-decoder and cross-decoder use causal masking. The overall architecture behaves like a decoder-only Transformer, autoregressively generating tokens.
